title: showThinkingSummaries Setting — Default-Off Thinking Summary Display (v2.1.88)

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature (v2.1.88). Zero integration friction — behavior is already the new default (summaries off unless opted in). Capability expansion is very low (25): this is a visibility control for reasoning output, not a new capability. The main action is a documentation note: (1) workflows that parsed thinking summaries programmatically must add showThinkingSummaries: true to settings.json, (2) registry entry in existing-capabilities.md. Score of 68.0 is NEEDS_RESEARCH, primarily because the workspace needs to verify no existing scripts/hooks depend on thinking summary output being present. If no such dependency exists, this is a pure registry note.
evaluation.action: RESEARCH: Check settings.json and hooks/ for any workflow that reads thinking summary output. If none found, add registry note to existing-capabilities.md under Extended Thinking and close. If found, add showThinkingSummaries: true to settings.json before closing.
